title: Add a new listing
subtitle: Choose the listing type to start the guided wizard.

vehicle.title: Vehicle listing
vehicle.description: Capture VIN, specs, pricing, and seller details for a vehicle.

part.title: Part listing
part.description: List accessories or parts with compatibility and condition details.

rent.title: Car for rent
rent.description: Rent out your car: price per day, deposit, conditions and an availability calendar.

form.title: Title
form.name: Name
form.vinHint: Optional. 17 characters: letters and digits, without I, O or Q.
form.listingBasicsHint: Set the public-facing title and description.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the condition, service history, or key details...
form.pricingHint: Define the asking price and finance options.
form.sellerHint: Add contact information shown to interested buyers.
form.showPhoneOnListing: Show phone number on public listing
form.photosHint: Add at least one image. Choose a main photo for preview.
form.partDetailsHint: Provide the key details about this part.
form.allCompleteMessage: All required sections are complete. You can publish the listing.
form.completeMissingMessage: Complete the missing sections to enable publishing.
form.publicImageHint: Make sure the image URL is publicly accessible.

validation.invalidVehicleCategory: Choose a category from the list
validation.invalidVehicleModel: Choose a model from the list for the selected brand
validation.invalidVehicleTrim: Choose a trim from the list
validation.invalidVin: VIN must be 17 characters: A–Z and 0–9, without I, O or Q.

success.title: Listing published
success.message: Your listing has been published successfully.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.loadDraftFailed: Failed to load this draft. Please try again.
errors.draftNotFoundHint: This draft does not exist or has been removed.

vehicleForm.specsNotFound: No data found — please fill in manually

rental.title: Rental terms
rental.hint: Renters will see these terms on the car page.
rental.depositHint: Leave empty if there is no deposit.

errors.minDays: Enter the minimum rental: a whole number from 1 to 365
errors.maxDays: Maximum rental: a whole number, not below the minimum (up to 365)
errors.kmPerDay: Kilometres: a whole number from 1 to 5000
errors.minDriverAge: Age: a whole number from 16 to 100

ai.hint: Describe the condition, history and equipment. Or let AI write the first draft.
ai.placeholder: Describe the condition, history and equipment. Or press “Write with AI”: it will build the text from the listing.
ai.needFacts: Fill in the make, model and year, and AI will be able to write the description.
ai.draftTitleMobile: AI draft. Check it before publishing
ai.draftHint: Check it and edit before publishing
ai.errorGeneric: The description could not be generated. Your text was not changed.
ai.errorRate: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again. Your text was not changed.
ai.errorUnavailable: AI is unavailable right now. Your text was not changed.
ai.bracketWarning: The description still has hints in brackets
ai.how1: It uses only the fields you have filled in.
ai.how2: What it does not know, it does not invent: it leaves a hint in brackets.
ai.how3: Nothing is published until you press “Next step”. You can edit the text as usual.

photoFocus.title: Photo in the listing card
photoFocus.hint: Drag the photo to choose the crop
photoFocus.aria: Main photo crop: drag or use the arrow keys

partAi.title: Fill in with AI
partAi.hint: Take a photo of the part: AI works out what it is and suggests the name, category, compatibility and description. You set the condition and price yourself.
partAi.pick: Upload a photo of the part
partAi.notPart: No car part is visible in the photo. Try another one: the part up close, in good light.
partAi.lowConfidence: AI is not sure about this result. Check the fields carefully.
partAi.noCompatibility: Compatibility cannot be told from the photo: add it yourself or photograph the label with the part number.
partAi.sellerSets: Set the condition (new or used) and the price yourself.
partAi.applied: Fields filled in. Check them and set the condition and price.
partAi.errorGeneric: Could not recognise the photo. Please try again.
partAi.errorRate: Too many requests. Try again later.
partAi.errorUnavailable: AI is unavailable right now. Fill in the fields by hand.
partAi.errorType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
partAi.errorSize: The photo is too large (20 MB max).
partAi.compatibilityGuess: AI guessed the compatibility from the look of the part, with no number on the photo. Check it against the part number or VIN before publishing.

translations.title: Translations
translations.hint: Your listing is written in {{language}}. The site shows these translations in the other languages; correct them if needed. If you change the original, the translations are made again.
